facts.fact: The ministry's page says the CSU, created by Decreto Regulamentar 7/2018, is the prior condition for access to public safety-net benefits such as social water and energy tariffs, school transport and kits, higher-education fee support and health user-fee exemption, and will be the reference database for municipalities, utilities, the health, education, housing and family ministries and the Centro Nacional de Pensões Sociais.

systems.owner: Ministério da Família, Inclusão e Desenvolvimento Social (MFIDS), with municipal CSU services

note: The page carries no date; as_of is the founding decree's date (the story's published date).
